description: Tract-level food-access dataset for Delaware's DGI program tracking. Covers DGI grant deployments (Cycles 1-5), Map the Meal Gap food insecurity apportioned to tracts via population-weighted areal interpolation, USDA LILA tracts, computed SB 254-effective tracts, the merged food-resource universe (SNAP retailers + farmers markets + DGI grantees), and supporting ACS demographics + DPH health overlays. Methodology v0.2.0 (definition-locked).
name: first-state-lens-dgi-food-access

resources.description: One row per DGI grant award. See schema/dgi-grants.json. Cycle 5 rows may carry a synthetic placeholder when DSB has not yet published awardees (methodology v0.2.0 Q1).
resources.name: dgi-grants
resources.title: DGI grant ledger (Cycles 1-5)

resources.description: GeoJSON Point features for every DGI grantee whose storefront address has been geocoded. Properties mirror the tabular dgi-grants ledger: cycle, grantee, amount_usd, category, tract_geoid, geocoding_confidence, wilmington_manual_reviewed. Pending-disbursement rows are excluded (no geometry).
resources.name: dgi-grants-geocoded
resources.title: DGI grantees as geocoded points

resources.description: Pass-through of the USDA Food Access Research Atlas tract-level shapefile, clipped to Delaware. LILA flag fields preserved from USDA: LILATracts_1And10, LILATracts_Vehicle, lapophalfshare, etc. Methodology v0.2.0 uses this as the federal-definition layer.
resources.name: usda-lila-tracts
resources.title: USDA LILA food-desert tracts (DE)

resources.description: Computed tract layer per methodology v0.2.0 Q6. Properties: tract_geoid, sb254_effective (bool), urbanicity, distance_threshold_mi, population_total, population_underserved, underserved_share, low_income (bool), low_income_reason, poverty_rate, mfi, mfi_ratio_to_state. See etl_parameters block for thresholds in effect.
resources.name: sb254-effective-tracts
resources.title: SB 254-effective tracts (state-statute interpretation)

resources.description: Map the Meal Gap county-level food-insecurity count, apportioned to Delaware Census tracts via population-weighted areal interpolation per methodology Q3. Properties: tract_geoid, food_insecurity_count_apportioned, food_insecurity_rate (intensive, county-level — repeated on every tract in the same county).
resources.name: food-insecurity-tracts
resources.title: Food insecurity apportioned to tracts (MMG)

resources.description: Deduplicated point set of SNAP retailers + DE farmers markets + DCFFP grantees + DGI grantees (methodology Q6 'food resource' set). Properties: name, sources (list of contributing pullers), categories, address, contributor_count. Dedupe within 30m + name similarity per etl.transforms.merge_food_resources.
resources.name: snap-retailers
resources.title: Merged food-resource universe

resources.description: Single-feature polygon of Sen. Brown's district. Extracted from the FirstMap statewide senate-districts dataset (2022 redistricting plan, valid through 2032).
resources.name: senate-district-2
resources.title: Senate District 2 boundary (FirstMap 2022 plan)

resources.description: LineString features derived from DART GTFS shapes.txt + routes.txt. Properties: route_id, route_short_name, route_long_name, route_type.
resources.name: dart-routes
resources.title: DART First State transit routes

resources.description: ACS 5-year tract-level demographics. See schema/acs-tract-demographics.json. Used downstream to compute the SB 254 low-income tract flag.
resources.name: acs-tract-demographics
resources.title: ACS tract-level demographics (DE)

resources.description: Tract-level health indicators (food insecurity, diabetes, obesity, SNAP household share). See schema/mhc-tract-health.json.
resources.name: mhc-tract-health
resources.title: DPH My Healthy Community health overlay

resources.description: Audit-trail rows for every flagged record. See schema/data-quality-flags.json.
resources.name: data-quality-flags
resources.title: Data quality flags

resources.description: Mirror of etl/parameters.yaml at run time, plus cycle_5_status and methodology_version. Carries the rules that produced the rest of the package.
resources.name: etl-parameters
resources.title: ETL parameters in effect for this build

resources.description: Per-source last_fetched + sha256, plus cycle_5_status. Lighter than datapackage.json for fast freshness checks.
resources.name: manifest
resources.title: Manifest (lightweight freshness cousin)

title: First State Lens — DGI Food Access Bulk Data
